reasoning_content:
Both .deb files exist on the archive host. Plan: modify `/workspace/deployment/postgres/Dockerfile` as follows:
1. Remove/fix the broken PGDG repository (it's still in the base image's sources).
2. Download the two pgrouting .deb files directly from `https://apt-archive.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/pool/main/p/pgrouting/` and install them with dpkg/apt.

Note that the postgresql-17-pgrouting package depends on postgresql-17-pgrouting-scripts, postgresql-17, and postgresql-17-postgis — all of which are already installed in the base image (postgis/postgis:17-3.5 includes postgresql-17 and postgis). Also libc6, libgcc-s1, and libstdc++6 are present.

Dockerfile update:
```dockerfile
FROM postgis/postgis:17-3.5

# The bullseye-pgdg repository referenced by the base image has been
# removed from apt.postgresql.org (Debian 11 is EOL). Install pgRouting
# directly from the PGDG archive instead.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl && \
    rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list && \
    curl -fsSL -o /tmp/pg_routing_3.8.0.deb \
      "https://apt-archive.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/pool/main/p/pgrouting/postgresql-17-pgrouting_3.8.0-1.pgdg110+1_amd64.deb" && \
    curl -fsSL -o /tmp/pg_routing_scripts_3.8.0.deb \
      "https://apt-archive.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/pool/main/p/pgrouting/postgresql-17-pgrouting-scripts_3.8.0-1.pgdg110+1_all.deb" && \
    dpkg -i /tmp/pg_routing_scripts_3.8.0.deb /tmp/pg_routing_3.8.0.deb && \
    rm -f /tmp/*.deb && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```
